title: FoJumpPads
description: Configurable launch pads with presets, effects, and safe landings.
body:
![FoJumpPads cover image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/WHDnPq5Y/images/3a293062d7839150a52fa7c674827120a6923dd6.png)

FoJumpPads lets admins create polished launch pads for hubs, parkour routes, minigames, and lobby shortcuts without hardcoding each location. Give a preset item, place it in the world, and the saved block becomes a configurable jump pad with its own launch style, cooldown, effects, and item design.

## Features
- Create persistent jump pads by placing preset items; saved pads load again after restarts.
- Start quickly with ready-made `default`, `high`, and `forward` presets.
- Tune each preset's horizontal force, vertical force, cooldown, fall-damage immunity, direction mode, sound, and particle.
- Choose player-facing, fixed north/east/south/west, or upward-only launch behavior.
- Use optional path lock to keep players moving cleanly along a chosen launch line.
- Manage pads from chat with list, teleport, and remove tools for quick cleanup.

## Admin Editor
- Open an in-game editor for global settings, disabled worlds, and preset management.
- Browse, search, add, edit, and delete jump pad presets without hand-editing every value.
- Copy the block, display name, lore, and custom model data from a held item into a preset.
- Edit sounds and particles through paged selector menus.

![Jump pad preset editor with configured launch pads](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/WHDnPq5Y/images/3540ea98b424b2d728d6cbd59ce249c4fac7e77a.png)

## Setup
1. Give an admin a preset item.
2. Place the item where players should launch.
3. Adjust presets and world settings from the editor or config files.

## Commands
- `/fojumppadsadmin editor` - Open the admin editor.
- `/fojumppadsadmin give <player> <preset> [amount]` - Give configured jump pad items.
- `/fojumppadsadmin list [page]` - List saved jump pads.
- `/fojumppadsadmin teleport <list-index>` - Teleport to a saved jump pad.
- `/fojumppadsadmin remove <radius|world|all> [value]` - Remove saved jump pads in bulk.
- `/fojumppadsadmin reload` - Reload config, messages, GUIs, and dialog text.
- `/fojumppadsadmin version` - Check the installed version and update status.

Alias: `/jumppadsadmin`

## Permissions
- `fojumppads.admin` - Allows all FoJumpPads admin commands, editor access, and update notices.
